deployments_detail.use: Company-wide generative-AI assistant (Smart Generative Chat) for meeting minutes, email/document editing, presentation drafting, FAQ generation, RAG over company data, and workflow automation across sales, manufacturing and admin divisions. [System Support Inc. (Smart Generative Chat)]
"PIG LABO Growth Master" 3D camera + AI infers individual pig weights & herd distribution

AI-driven demand forecasting and inventory allocation for the processed-foods business, built on SAP BTP alongside SAP S/4HANA (the 'Connect Project'). Replaces veteran-intuition manual planning with data-driven forecasts to cut stockouts and optimize perishable stock. [SAP (SAP BTP, SAP S/4HANA)]

PIG LABO smart pig-farming system: AI/IoT sensors collect barn-environment and pig-behavior big data; AI analyzes it to monitor pig health, welfare and enable data-driven herd management (co-developed with NTT Data), aiming to codify veteran-farmer expertise. [NTT Data (PIG LABO)]

PIG LABO Breeding Master: Japan-first AI estrus (heat) detection service for sows, launched as a test service under the Smart Pig Farming project, using AI image analysis to detect breeding timing. [NTT Data SBC (PIG LABO Breeding Master)]

AI image-recognition inspection equipment on production lines detecting foreign materials (animal hair, hard/soft bone/cartilage fragments) in products and raw materials; retrainable AI improves detection accuracy and reduces inspector workload. In operation. [none]
"GC Analysis" — generative-AI consumer pseudo-personas answer surveys (Azure OpenAI)

Generative-AI next-generation ordering platform: sales reps input orders by voice or chat in natural language, and generative AI converts them into structured order data auto-linked to SAP S/4HANA. Currently a proof of concept using SAP Business AI. [SAP (SAP Business AI)]

Generated-Customer (GC) analysis: Azure OpenAI creates synthetic consumer personas from ~20,000 real consumer profiles to run virtual surveys, accelerating product-development proposals to retail/convenience-store partners. Python UI, GPT-4o mini. [Microsoft (Azure OpenAI Service, GPT-4o mini, Azure App Service)]
deployments_detail.value: 1,000-person survey in 45 minutes vs 1-2 months traditionally; ~100+ yen per run

deployments_detail.use: Voice-of-Customer (VOC) analysis via the Flyle generative-AI insight platform in the Customer-Centric Promotion Department: high-precision Japanese context analysis, AI auto-tagging and quantitative VOC dashboards replacing legacy text mining. [Flyle, Inc. (Flyle)]
deployments_detail.value: Weekly reporting cut from 15-16 hours (3 people) to 3-4 hours (1 person)

deployments_detail.use: Generative-AI-created phishing-email variations (HENNGE Tadrill) used to run simulated phishing security-awareness training and measure open rates across ~13,000 employees, feeding a PDCA security-literacy program. [HENNGE (HENNGE One / Tadrill)]
